item.title: How to get the square root of a number in JavaScript
item.description: Calculating square roots is important for geometric calculations, distance formulas, statistical analysis, and data visualization in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used square root calculations in geometric utilities, chart scaling, and physics-based animations. For rounding results before display, see how to round a number in JavaScript.

item.title: How to provide a service in Angular root module
item.description: Providing services in the root module ensures they are available throughout the entire application as singletons, which is essential for shared state and global functionality. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve configured root-level services in numerous Angular applications. From my expertise, the most modern approach is using providedIn: 'root' in the service decorator, which automatically provides the service at the root level. This creates tree-shakable services and ensures optimal bundle size.
